content: Kuxinetate yuarikayari
Yawé Muitsexi mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe:
«Hutame kuxineta titsunamekɨ keneutiwewi pɨratakɨ wewiyatɨkaime, mana memukutei pemɨwakuxexeɨriwanitsie keneutahɨtsiwani meta kepauka memayekɨnetsie.
Kepauka hutatɨ mɨtiyuani, yunaitɨ teɨteri 'ahamatɨa mekaniyukuxeɨrikuni 'ixuriki tukiyari mɨranutahakitɨretsie.
Kepauka xewitɨ xeikɨa mɨtayuani, 'ahamatɨa mekaniyukuxeɨrikuni xeikɨa memanuyetei 'Ixaheri nuiwarimama.
Kuxineta haikakɨa hetayuayu memɨyehutsiemieme, mekananuyeyaxikuni tau makayuyuipiketsie memɨtitei,
hutariekata tatsutɨa memɨtitei. 'Ana kanitayuamɨkɨ kuxineta memɨyehutsie 'amemayekɨnekɨ.
Kepauka memɨyuxeɨrikuni mematiteitsie kuxineta kanitayuamɨkɨ yɨkɨ pɨta tiuyuatɨ.
»Kuxineta memɨtihɨtsieni mawari wewiwamete 'Aruni niwemama mekateniyurikuni. 'Ikɨ 'aitsika kanihɨkɨtɨkamɨkɨ xehetsiemieme meta xenuiwarima.

»Kepaukari yukwietsie xemeta'axɨani xemayekɨne xekaneyɨwawekuni xeheyutakwinike memɨxe'aye'unie wahetsɨa, mɨkɨ kuxineta kanitiyuamɨkɨ kepauka xemeyutakwini. Hikɨ 'ana xeme Yawé kanixehaye'erimɨkɨ kanixetawikweitsitɨamɨkɨ memɨxe'aye'unie watsata.

»Kepauka 'ixɨarari waɨkawa meuyewetse xemutiwewiwani, meta metseri mɨhekwa tukariyari 'anatsiere xekateniutihɨtsiwakuni mawari taiyariyari memewewienikɨ meta 'aixɨa memɨteyuxeiyani mawariyari hetsiemieme. 'Ana Kakaɨyari xeme pɨxehaye'erieni. Ne Yawé 'akakaɨyari nekanihɨkɨtɨni».
Tsinahi memɨyekɨ Parani memu'axɨa
Xeitewiyari tukari 'umiekaku hutarieka metseriyaritsie, hutarieka wiyaritsie, hai kananuku'ene tuki heima.
Hikɨ 'ixaheritsixi Tsinahi mekaniyekɨne memakutekaitsie makumawetsie paitɨ mekaniu'axɨani, Parani mɨrakutewatsie hai hakewa meuyeya.
Yawé Muitsexi kemɨtiuta'aitɨa, 'ana 'ixaheritsixi mekaniyekɨne matɨari.
Matɨari memanuyeyaxixɨ Kura teɨterimama mekaniyɨakaitɨni yupatera me'akwetɨ. Kaniwara'iniekaitɨni Nahatsuni titewatɨ 'Aminarawi nu'aya.
Natanaheri Tsuhaxi nu'aya kaniwara'iniekaitɨni 'Itsakaxi nuiwarimama.
'Eriyáwi Heruni nu'aya kaniwara'iniekaitɨni Tsawuruni nuiwarimama.
Hikɨ tuki 'utaxɨnarieka, Keritsuni nuiwarimama meta meraritsixi mete'utɨtɨ mekanekɨne.
Wa'utɨmata memayekɨ Xuweni teɨterimama mekaniyɨakaitɨni yupatera me'akwetɨ. Kaniwarawitɨkɨkaitɨni 'Eritsuxi Tserehuxi nu'aya.
Tserumieri Tsuritsarahi nu'aya Tsimehuni nuiwarimama kaniwarawitɨkɨkaitɨni,
'Eriyatsati Rehuheri nu'aya Kahari nuiwarimama kaniwarawitɨkɨkaitɨni.
Hikɨta mɨkɨ wa'utɨa mekanekɨne Kuhatitsixi mɨtipatsietɨka tetɨkɨmete. 'Ixuriki tukiyari kaniutawewierikekaitɨni mexi meka'uye'axɨawaweni hakewa memetiyaxe.
Mɨkɨta wa'utɨma mekanekɨne 'Epɨrahini teɨterimama yupatera me'akwetɨ. Mɨkɨ 'Eritsama 'Amihuri nu'aya kaniwarawitɨkɨkaitɨni.
Kamarieri Peratsuxi nu'aya Manatsexi nuiwarimama kaniwarawitɨkɨkaitɨni,
'Awirani Kereuni nu'aya Wenikamini nuiwarimama kaniwarawitɨkɨkaitɨni.
'Imatɨrieka yunaime wahɨwemete mekanayekɨne Rani teɨterimama yupatera me'akwetɨ. 'Akihetsexi 'Amitsarahi nu'aya kaniwarawitɨkɨkaitɨni.
Pakieri 'Ukɨrani nu'aya, 'Atsexi nuiwarimama kaniwarawitɨkɨkaitɨni,
'Akira 'Enahani nu'aya, Nepɨtahari nuiwarimama kaniwarawitɨkɨkaitɨni.
Mɨpaɨ mekateneuku'ukaitɨni 'ixaheritsixi kepauka memayekɨkakai.
Muitsexi Huwawi kemɨtiuta'ini

Hikɨ Muitsexi Huwawi Xehueri mariyani tewiyari nu'aya mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: —Tame tepayekɨnirɨme Yawé kwie mɨtatsi'axatɨatsie. Hikɨmɨ tanaitɨ tekaniyehuni 'aixɨa temɨteheyuxeiyanikɨ, Yawé 'ixaheritsixi wahetsiemieme 'aixɨa mɨtiuka'iyarikɨ.
Huwawi mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Ne hawaikɨ, ne nepɨkayemie, ne nekwiepa pɨta nekaniyemieni nemarema wahetsɨa.
Muitsexi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Neuxeitsɨ, pepɨkatatsi'uku'e'eiriwani, 'Ekɨ pepukumate makumawetsie hakewa temeka'uxipiweni. 'Ekɨ pemɨtatsi'anuwitɨni pepɨhɨkɨtɨni.
Xɨka petatsi heweiya, tame tematsi heyetuirieni 'aixɨa mɨti'ane Yawé mɨtareyetuirieni.
Kepauka 'ixaheritsixi memayekɨ
'Ixaheritsixi mekanayekɨne Yawé hɨrieya manukatsie, haika tukari mekaniuhukaitɨni Yawé tɨratuya mayeka me'akwetɨ, wahɨxie kaniumiekaitɨni 'ikuwaunetɨ hakewa memeka'uxipienikekai.
Kepauka memayekɨkakai, Yawé haiwitɨrieya waheima tukarikɨ puyeyeixakai.
